issues.title: Vibe capabilities were not exposed as one operator workflow
issues.detail: Manifest generation, simulator smoke, Galaxy status, live runtime, and evidence generation previously required separate commands and could report stale state.
issues.resolution: vibe.ps1 workflow now coordinates the lanes under one RunId and emits workflow-status.json plus a run-specific evidence bundle.

issues.title: SC2 API port selection was flaky across consecutive launches
issues.detail: A prior 5000 launch could leave the next runtime attempt without a usable API port.
issues.resolution: Live workflow attempts Sc2Port and Sc2Port+1, records both outcomes, reuses a verified packed map when available, and keeps attempts isolated. stage14-live-final3 passed on port 5001.

issues.title: Runtime packaging could retain stale files from a previous attempt
issues.detail: A failed packaging tail could leave old launcher-exit or map-pack reports beside current generic runtime verdicts.
issues.resolution: Each attempt is snapshotted under Stage 14; current launcher-exit is regenerated, stale pack reports are removed when the verified packed map is reused, and the final bundle contains 19 current hashed items.

issues.title: Stage 13 harness packaging tail can outlive the runtime verdict
issues.detail: The compliant launcher produced current runtime evidence, but the Stage 13 wrapper did not return before the operator timeout.
issues.resolution: Stage 14 bounds each harness invocation at LiveTimeoutSec and only derives PASS from current launcher VERDICT exit code 0, current 2/2 assertions, current ScriptError has_new_errors=false, and current vibe-verdict.passed=true.

issues.title: Registered legacy sc2-editor-toolkit path remains unavailable
issues.detail: workflow status reports parser.legacy_toolkit as warn; the registered Galaxy toolkit, map extractor, and cold static validator remain available and passing.
issues.nextAction: Correct the registered legacy path or make the dependency explicitly optional in a later parser-focused stage.

issues.title: This operator smoke does not collect visual verdicts
issues.detail: The runtime gate is launcher/API/assertion/ScriptError based; visual-verdict.json is absent by design for this headless smoke.
issues.nextAction: Add a desktop visual lane only when the next application scenario requires visual validation.

issues.title: AI ally x Dead of Night application scenario is not part of Stage 14
issues.detail: Stage 14 stabilizes the workflow control plane; it does not expand the two-assertion runtime smoke into strategic ally behavior.
issues.nextAction: Use the Stage 14 operator workflow as the execution surface for the next AI ally application stage.
